business_problem: centralize analytics and near-real-time reporting for a fast-growing conversational AI business so Omilia could refine model performance, simplify data operations, and speed deployments.
solution_summary: Omilia uses Snowflake and Horizon Catalog on Snowflake to centralize analytics and near-real-time reporting for a fast-growing conversational AI business so Omilia could refine model performance, simplify data operations, and speed deployments. Application, customer, event, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so support, operations, and customer-success teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Horizon Catalog adds cataloging, governance, and policy controls that make broader data access safer to operate at scale. The platform also connects with AWS so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Omilia achieved 33% Faster deployment times and 100s Of DevOps hours saved per month.
